finding: Moves and renames had no file transaction undo history. Ctrl+Z was not reassigned; the tree handled clipboard keys but had no file undo route.

upstream.adopted: Explorer focus/source routing, reversed file paths and one operation per batch through the existing document relocation service

coverage: collision preflight leaves the entire batch unchanged

ui.input: Trusted Electron key events for Ctrl+Z/Y/Shift+Z; DOM context-menu actions; production tree with isolated filesystem and file history
coverage: editor input does not move files
dirty rename keeps model and editor undo identity
native editor and terminal shortcut ownership

native.input: DOM drag and Ctrl+Z/Y events in original Typora 1.14.10; not a physical OS gesture
coverage: source model and saved changes survive undo/redo
native Markdown dirty draft survives undo/redo
subsequent save uses the replayed path

installation.coverage: Same candidate public install/check/restore-uninstall/reinstall/check/detach-uninstall/reinstall/check, four startup mode updates, failure/cancellation/rollback

local.uninstall: Read-only preflight only in user environment

limits: History begins with operations in the loaded new version; old moves cannot be reconstructed.
History is scoped to the current window/workspace, with at most 100 batches; workspace switches and unsupported mutations invalidate it.
Copy/create/trash undo and cross-window/restart history are not implemented by this change.
No physical OS input, non-Windows/SSH native acceptance or full UI suite.
cleanup: All final core/UI/native/isolated install/uninstall managed payloads were reclaimed; logs and screenshots retained.
